description: Structured eval definitions for the Polly Voice Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Polly TTS scenarios (neural real-time synthesis with lexicon, async batch to S3 via start-speech-synthesis-task, SSML with standard engine full tag support, speech marks for lip-sync, SSML break/emphasis on neural engine which silently fails). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Neural real-time synthesis with custom lexicon
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — neural engine, voice Joanna en-US, MP3 24000 Hz, lexicon company-terms referenced, real-time synthesize-speech mode, per-character cost estimate
eval_cases.prompt: Configure Amazon Polly to synthesize a greeting message using the neural engine. Voice: Joanna (en-US, Female). Output format: MP3 at 24000 Hz. Use a lexicon named company-terms (already uploaded) so that "AWS" and "EC2" are pronounced correctly. The text is: "Welcome to AWS. Your EC2 instance is ready." This is a real-time synthesis for a web application. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=greeting.
eval_cases.expected_output:
POLLY_VOICE: Joanna (neural engine, en-US)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: neural
  [✓] Voice: Joanna (en-US, Female)
  [✓] Voice available on engine: PASS
  [✓] SSML compatibility: plain text — PASS
  [✓] Output format: mp3
  [✓] Sample rate: 24000 Hz — PASS
  [✓] Lexicon: company-terms — uploaded
  [✓] Synthesis mode: real-time (synthesize-speech)
  [✓] Estimated cost: $0.000832 (52 chars × $16/1M)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws polly describe-voices --engine neural --query 'Voices[?Id==`Joanna`]'
  aws polly list-lexicons --query 'Lexicons[?Name==`company-terms`]'

eval_cases.name: Asynchronous batch synthesis to S3 with long-form engine
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — long-form engine, voice Joanna en-US, async start-speech-synthesis-task to S3 bucket my-polly-output, MP3 24000 Hz, cost estimate for 50K chars
eval_cases.prompt: Configure Amazon Polly to batch-synthesize a 50,000-character article to S3 using the long-form engine. Voice: Joanna (en-US). Output format: MP3 at 24000 Hz. S3 output bucket: my-polly-output, key prefix: audio/articles/. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=audiobook.
eval_cases.expected_output:
POLLY_VOICE: Joanna (long-form engine, en-US)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: long-form
  [✓] Voice: Joanna (en-US, Female)
  [✓] Output format: mp3
  [✓] Sample rate: 24000 Hz — PASS
  [✓] Synthesis mode: async (start-speech-synthesis-task → s3://my-polly-output/audio/articles/)
  [✓] Estimated cost: $5.00 (50000 chars × $100/1M)

eval_cases.name: SSML synthesis with standard engine (full tag support)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — standard engine selected for full SSML support (break, emphasis, prosody, phoneme), voice Matthew en-US, MP3 24000 Hz
eval_cases.prompt: Configure Amazon Polly to synthesize speech using SSML. The SSML uses <break time="500ms"/>, <emphasis level="strong">, and <prosody rate="slow"> tags. Voice: Matthew (en-US). Output: MP3 at 24000 Hz. Text includes phoneme tags for IPA pronunciation. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=ivr.
eval_cases.expected_output:
POLLY_VOICE: Matthew (standard engine, en-US)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: standard
  [✓] Voice: Matthew (en-US, Male)
  [✓] SSML compatibility: break, emphasis, prosody, phoneme — PASS (all supported on standard)
  [✓] Output format: mp3
  [✓] Sample rate: 24000 Hz — PASS

eval_cases.name: Speech marks generation for lip-sync animation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — speech marks generated as separate request (OutputFormat=json), viseme and word mark types, two-request pattern (audio + marks) noted
eval_cases.prompt: Configure Amazon Polly to generate speech marks for lip-sync animation. Voice: Joanna (en-US, neural engine). Need viseme and word-level marks. Output: JSON speech marks file. Also need the corresponding MP3 audio file. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=avatar-lipsync.
eval_cases.expected_output:
POLLY_VOICE: Joanna (neural engine, en-US)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: neural
  [✓] Voice: Joanna (en-US, Female)
  [✓] Speech marks: viseme, word (separate request, OutputFormat=json)
  [✓] Audio: MP3 at 24000 Hz (separate request from marks)

eval_cases.name: SSML break/emphasis tags on neural engine (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — <break> and <emphasis> tags only work with standard engine; neural silently ignores them
eval_cases.prompt: Configure Amazon Polly neural voice synthesis with SSML. Use voice Joanna (neural engine). The SSML includes <break time="500ms"/> between sentences and <emphasis level="strong"> on key terms. Output: MP3 at 24000 Hz. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
POLLY_VOICE: Joanna (neural engine, en-US)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] SSML compatibility: FAIL — <break> and <emphasis> tags are only supported by the standard engine; neural silently ignores them. Switch to standard engine, or remove these tags and use <prosody> for timing.
